FN-XS6BEE-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 199
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Randall Shedd
Commissions
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 03/27/2023
House Bill 199 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Security Regulatory
Board until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise
affect state or local funding.
